study: Schoen et al. 2020 (Replicating the CGI Experiment, Grade 1-2 math, Year 1; FCR-STEM/FSU report 2020-02)
delivery_evidence: CGI PD (TDG) was '48 hours of face-to-face, workshop-based professional development per teacher' in Year 1: a four-day summer workshop/institute plus two two-day during-year follow-up sessions (Sec. 3.2.1, p.19; 'face-to-face, workshop-based').
test_alignment_evidence: Included outcomes mix two broad independent standardized tests (ITBS Math Problems, ITBS Math Computation) with a researcher/developer-made measure (MPAC math interview) (Tables 5.1-5.2, pp.39-40; Measures).
curriculum_evidence: Explicit: 'The CGI PD program does not provide a script or curriculum for teachers to follow in the classroom' (Discussion, p.~56); CGI develops teachers' knowledge of children's mathematical thinking to use with their existing district curriculum/textbook.
outcome_timing_evidence: Confirmatory effect sizes are end-of-Year-1 (spring 2014) student achievement, i.e., at the end of the first program year (Sec. 5 / Tables 5.1-5.2; timepoint 'post / spring 2014').
